dawson-trotman.bio: Through the worldwide Christian organization he founded, The Navigators, Dawson Trotman helped bring back some forgotten Biblical truths: maintaining the basic disciplines of the Christ-centered Spirit-filled life, abiding in the Word of God, the importance of personal follow-up, one-on-one discipleship training, and principles for multiplying Christian disciples, laborers, and equippers around the world.
dawson-trotman.line: Founded The Navigators and pioneered one-on-one discipleship.
dawson-trotman.about: Dawson Trotman founded The Navigators and helped recover simple, forgotten practices of the Christian life: time in the Word, Scripture memory, prayer, personal follow-up and one-on-one discipleship. His talks are short and urgent, about reproducing your faith in others (“Born to Reproduce”), world vision, and believing God for big things.

ruth-myers.bio: Ruth Myers and her late husband, Warren, have served on staff with the Navigators, an international, non-denominational mission organization, and as missionaries in Singapore for many years. In addition to her personal, one-on-one ministry, Ruth is a popular conference speaker. She is the author of The Perfect Love, from which the new devotional The Satisfied Heart is adapted. She has authored numerous books...
ruth-myers.line: Missionary in Singapore. Author of The Satisfied Heart.
ruth-myers.about: Ruth Myers served with The Navigators and as a missionary in Singapore alongside her husband Warren, and wrote The Satisfied Heart. Her messages are warm and practical, often for women, on God's love, emotions and healing, self-image, dating, courtship and marriage.

leroy-eims.bio: LeRoy Eims served with The Navigators for over 50 years in a variety of ministries, including Director of U.S. Ministries, International Ministry Representative, and Director of Evangelism Worldwide. He broadened his ministry through the writing of 14 books, including the best-selling The Lost Art of Disciplemaking. His personal ministry continues on through the lives of his family, and through countless scores of people in harvest fields around the world who bear witness to his faithful labors with them.
leroy-eims.line: 50+ years with The Navigators. Wrote The Lost Art of Disciplemaking.
leroy-eims.about: LeRoy Eims served with The Navigators for over 50 years, including as Director of U.S. Ministries and of Evangelism Worldwide, and wrote 14 books including The Lost Art of Disciplemaking. His large library covers discipleship, the basics of the Christian life, wisdom, the lordship of Christ and witnessing, plus a walk through the whole Bible and the daily 4-minute capsules.

irma-warr.line: Taught The Godly Woman, a 23-part study for women.
irma-warr.about: Irma Warr is best known in this library for The Godly Woman, a 23-part study for women. Her talks focus on marriage and the home, forgiveness, obedience and the lordship of Christ, with practical help for women growing in their walk with God.

jerry-bridges.bio: Jerry Bridges is a well-known Christian writer and conference speaker. He is author of several books, including The Pursuit of Holiness, The Pursuit of Godliness, and The Discipline of Grace. He has been on the staff of The Navigators since 1955 and currently serves as a resource person to the Navs University Students Ministry throughout the United States. Jerry and his wife Jane live in Colorado Springs, Colorado. They have two married children and six grandchildren.
jerry-bridges.line: Author of The Pursuit of Holiness. Navigators staff since 1955.
jerry-bridges.about: Jerry Bridges joined The Navigators staff in 1955 and wrote The Pursuit of Holiness, The Pursuit of Godliness and The Discipline of Grace. His talks dig into holiness, grace, the character of God, true fellowship and the Spirit-filled life: careful teaching on how grace changes everyday living.

kirkie-morrissey.bio: Kirkie Morrissey speaks at both local and national conferences and also teaches a class at her church. She is the author of several books and writes newsletter articles for ministry organizations. Even though her manner is gentle, she speaks powerfully, having emerged from her own difficulties more firmly established in her faith and with greater excitement for the Lord. Kirkie lives in Colorado Springs, Colorado.
kirkie-morrissey.line: Author and conference speaker on faith, joy and walking with God through hard seasons.
kirkie-morrissey.about: Kirkie Morrissey speaks at local and national conferences, teaches a class at her church and has written several books. Gentle but powerful, she draws on her own hard seasons; her talks explore faith, joy, the resurrection, the character of God and studies in Isaiah, often for women.

lorne-sanny.bio: Lorne Sanny, mentored by Navigator founder Dawson Trotman, was the Navigator General Director for 30 years. Loren Sanny is a man who has lived his life consistently following Christ. His life is an example to anyone who wants to finish well in life. He has extensive discipling experience and generously passes it on to others. You will learn from him how you too can become an effective disciplemaker.
lorne-sanny.line: Mentored by Trotman; led The Navigators for 30 years.
lorne-sanny.about: Lorne Sanny was mentored by Dawson Trotman and led The Navigators as General Director for 30 years. His teaching centers on discipleship and spiritual multiplication, the Word of God, leadership and ministry: practical wisdom from a lifetime of making disciples.

jim-downing.bio: After a 24-year Navy career, Jim Downing has served on staff with The Navigators for 27 years in many capacities, including Deputy President and Chairman of the Board of Directors. Morena Downing, Jim's wife of 68 years, went home to be with the Lord in February, 2010. Jim maintains a heavy speaking schedule as he ministers throughout The Navigator ministries. From Jim you will learn how to abide in the Word of God, apply it to your own life, and move on to maturity as a laborer for Jesus Christ.
jim-downing.line: 24 years in the Navy, then a lifetime of making disciples.
jim-downing.about: After a 24-year Navy career, Jim Downing served on The Navigators staff in many roles, including Deputy President and Chairman of the Board. His talks focus on the devotional life, abiding in and applying God's Word, prayer, the second coming, and growing to maturity as a laborer for Christ.
